title: Sick Bastard
tagline: Get conversations with getting better and sickness verified from real doctor for less pricing.
description: People are taking help of claude, chatgpt and other LLMs when they find themselves sick. Although it can be risky to trust them blindly as they are prone to convincing. It is important to get the conversations verified by actual doctor. This is exactly what we are doing, we are getting the conversations you have had on medical issues with a doctor in the middle. The LLM is quicker, easily available and thus is the first response for people. The doctors' can review and suggest what next to do.
how_its_made: We are building a UI for doctor to verify the conversation and also add to the prompt. So the doctor can earn money using our portals and it will take them very little time. Doctor also doesn't have to answer the silly questions of patients often prevelant in developing economies. The doctor will get consolidated report on patient <> AI conversation and they can verify. Each verification gets them to earn some money for their work.
